notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a land.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Dune-Brood Nephilim and the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury and Dune-Brood Nephilim trigger.
Resolve the Dune-Brood Nephilim trigger, creating a 1/1 Sand creature token for each land you control.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Sand token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
